nrr:aiUseDeclaration.statement: We used Claude (Opus 4.8, Opus 5) to suggest wording ideas, copy-edit draft text to match Arcadia's style, clarify and streamline text, and generate figure mockups. We used ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Luna) to suggest wording ideas and to clarify and streamline text. We also used ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Sol) to identify reproducibility/clarity issues in our draft, and we corrected the issues it found. Additionally, Gemini (Gemini 3.6 Flash) suggested papers on relevant science, we did further reading, and we cited some of this literature. We reviewed all AI-assisted content and take responsibility for its accuracy and integrity.

nrr:applicabilityConditions.alcalase: 1:10 dilution of Alcalase (Sigma-Aldrich 126741) in TAP, 10 mL per pellet, 1 h in LED grow tent (~7,000 lux, ambient temperature, no shaking); washed twice with TAP + 40 mM sucrose
nrr:applicabilityConditions.cargo: Alt-R S. pyogenes Cas9 V3 (IDT 1081058) with annealed Alt-R crRNA:tracrRNA (IDT 1072533), 5 uM each, 4 uL RNP per reaction; linear 1,589 bp HDR donor: HSP70A-RBCS2::RBCS2i1::NAT::RBCS2-T flanked by 50 bp homology arms, released by SapI (NEB R0569S), gel-purified (Zymo D4001), 1 ug per transformation; synthesised by Twist Bioscience in pTwist Amp High Copy
nrr:applicabilityConditions.comparator: washed twice in 10 mL undiluted GeneArt MAX Efficiency Transformation Reagent for Algae (Thermo Fisher A24229)
nrr:applicabilityConditions.delivery: Gene Pulser Xcell (Bio-Rad), 4 mm cuvettes (VWR 89047-210), 500 V, 50 uF, 800 Ohm; 250 uL cells; recovery overnight in TAP + 40 mM sucrose, dark, 150 rpm
nrr:applicabilityConditions.replicates: n = 1 per condition; one experimenter; one batch of each key reagent
nrr:applicabilityConditions.selection: TAP agar + 7.5 ug/mL nourseothricin (NAT); controls plated on TAP after 100x dilution; 5-7 days in grow tent
nrr:applicabilityConditions.synchronization: 14 h light / 10 h dark for four days before transformation; Fluval Plant 4.0 LED Nano lamps, 11,000 lux at culture surface

nrr:confidence.basis: one attempt, one reagent batch, one experimenter; authors state Alcalase is not ruled out under gentler conditions

nrr:cost.note: single unreplicated experiment; USD not reported
nrr:cost.source: Figure 1 legend: workflow spans ~18 days from culture synchronization to genotyping

@graph.nrr:hypothesis: Establish a robust, high-throughput-compatible CRISPR-Cas9 knock-in (HDR) system in cell-walled C. reinhardtii as a prerequisite for modular landing pads (Bigge et al. 2026, doi:10.57844/arcadia-61hk-a7gd); test Alcalase as an off-the-shelf substitute for autolysin.
nrr:invalidators: a milder Alcalase regime (lower dose, shorter time, osmotic support) that preserves viability
a positive editing control showing the guides, donor and selection work in a known-working delivery system
replication with independent reagent batches and experimenters
nrr:nextSteps: Develop a robust, CRISPR-compatible cell wall digestion method: improve autolysin (Shetty et al. 2025: mating at 28 C rather than 18 C) or gentler Alcalase (Walker et al. 2026, diatoms: osmotic support during and after digestion; titrate the enzyme dose down).
Separate delivery failures from editing failures: restore a visual screen to confirm the guides, donor and selection work; include a donor-only, no-RNP control to estimate off-target NHEJ.
Optimize on-target editing: co-target an endogenous selectable marker (Akella et al. 2021; Ross et al. 2024); tune RNP and donor concentrations and ratio (Kim et al. 2020 reached ~37% knock-in).
nrr:openQuestions: Has anyone gotten Alcalase pretreatment to work in C. reinhardtii? If so, what digestion time, concentration, and recovery conditions did you use?
If you've gotten autolysin preparations working consistently, which factors mattered most?
If we try making targeted knock-ins again, what 'need-to-haves' do you think we missed?
@graph.nrr:outcomeSummary: Alcalase digested walls but killed most cells before electroporation, gave near-background NAT resistance, and neither reagent yielded any on-target editing among 191 colonies screened; the project was iced (#TechnicalGap, #StrategicMisalignment).
nrr:provenanceNotes: Encoded from the published text, tables and the Zenodo CSVs; imaging and gel raw files are pointed to, not parsed.

Icebox statement: We've paused targeted integration work in C. reinhardtii after this attempt because optimizing this approach would likely require additional time and resources, and our research priorities have shifted.

Authors' caveat: This was a single, unreplicated experiment performed by one experimenter using one batch of each key reagent, so our conclusions are limited to the conditions described here and shouldn't be read as an evaluation of any individual component of the workflow.
@graph.nrr:successCriteria: NAT-resistant colonies well above the no-donor background after Alcalase pretreatment, and on-target HDR insertion (~2 kb amplicon or sequence-confirmed edit) detectable among them at a rate usable for high-throughput screens.
